scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. Every contact always has a next follow-up, and the late ones sit at the top, oldest first.
But the useful part is what broke. Owner-only buttons were hidden, so the checks couldn't even try them. And unarchiving a contact with no follow-up date had no rule.

HubSpot's free CRM covers two users, and paid seats start at fifteen dollars per seat per month. If your team works from contacts, deals and follow-ups, you mostly need the list, the board, and the reminder.
